seo_title: Fjor Case Study: Keto App Messaging on Meta | SOMIN
description: SOMIN read 3,676 Meta ads from 10 diet and fitness apps for Fjor and found its US audience over-indexes on social media shopping, at a GWI index of about 302.
eyebrow: Brand case study · Health and fitness apps · USA
h1: Fjor's keto audience buys visible results, not health lectures
lede: SOMIN read 3,676 Meta ads from Fjor's keto-app rivals, such as BetterMe and Noom, and refined Fjor's messages with GWI data: its US audience over-indexes on social media shopping, at about 302.
meta_line: A SOMIN brand briefing · April 2024 – April 2025 · USA · Social network product researchers interested in fitness and health food

stats.label: GWI index for social media shoppers

challenge.title: What Fjor's rivals say in their best-performing Meta ads
challenge.body: Which personas and pain points do rivals address in their best ads, and how should Fjor speak to its audience?

approach.title: 3,676 Meta ads, two stories and a GWI audience check
points: Read app-install ads from 10 apps with above-average predicted CTR.
Picked a focus persona and pain point.
Wrote two stories and key messages in three tones.
Refined each message with GWI audience data.

findings_title: Rivals hold the focus persona, and the audience is social first

findings.title: Three rivals address the focus pain point while Fjor lags
findings.body: OrganicFit, BetterMe and Mad Muscles App address Challenges in Building Healthy Habits and Achieving Fitness Goals.

findings.title: Five rivals win the Wellness Enthusiast persona
findings.body: BetterMe, Noom, Mad Muscles, OrganicFit and Atkins, with above-average predicted CTR.

findings.title: The audience over-indexes on social shopping, at about 302
findings.body: Also influencer recommendations (~204) and a social 'buy' button (~192); learning new skills is ~56.

delivered.title: Fjor's key messages, rewritten with GWI audience data
points: Persona and pain-point maps of rivals' top Meta ads
Two stories with key messages in three tones
A GWI audience profile with top over- and under-indexes
GWI-refined messages with reasons and ad mock-ups

quote.text: Avoid heavy messaging on education, deep health rationale, or saving money incentives - this audience is emotionally and socially motivated, not rationally or practically.

outcome.title: Fjor should sell visible results, status and lifestyle
outcome.body: SOMIN recommends a shareable narrative of visible results, status and lifestyle, carried by influencers, user-generated content and aesthetic campaigns. 'A quiet decision to believe in yourself' becomes 'a moment in the spotlight'.

faq.q: Which apps were in the competitive set?
faq.a: Keto Diet (YourKetoPlan), OrganicFit, Unimeal, BetterMe: Health Coaching, Carb Manager, Keto Cycle, Atkins, Keto Diet App (Fjor), Noom and Mad Muscles App.

faq.q: What did the GWI data add?
faq.a: Messages were rewritten towards appearance, confidence and social validation, with the index behind each change.
Education, achievement or rational messaging, health fear tactics and medical narratives; the audience under-indexes on learning and success.
